# 89 cấu trúc viết lại câu

1. $\text{S} + \text{be} + \text{adj enough } (\text{for sb}) + \text{to V}$
$\hookrightarrow$ Ex: The question is easy enough for Ann to answer.

2. $\text{S} + \text{V} + \text{enough noun } (\text{for sb}) + \text{to V}$
$\hookrightarrow$ Ex: Ann has enough time to do her homework.

3. $\text{S} + \text{last} + \text{V(ed)} + \text{time} + \text{ago}$
$\hookrightarrow$ Ex: Ann last saw him 2 week ago.

4. $\text{It's been} + \text{time} + \text{since} + \text{S} + \text{last} + \text{V(ed)}$
$\hookrightarrow$ Ex: It's been 2 weeks since Ann last saw him.

5. $\text{The last time} + \text{S} + \text{V(ed)} + \text{was} + \text{time}$
$\hookrightarrow$ Ex: The last time Ann saw him was 2 weeks ago.

6. $\text{Although/Even though} + \text{S} + \text{V,...}$
$\hookrightarrow$ Ex: Although it rained, Ann went out.

7. $\text{Despite/In spite of} + \text{N/gerund (Ving)}$
$\hookrightarrow$ Ex: Despite the rain, Ann went out.

8. $\text{Despite/In spite of the fact that} + \text{S} + \text{V,...}$
$\hookrightarrow$ Ex: Despite the fact that it rained, Ann went out.

9. $\text{There's no point in Ving}$
$\hookrightarrow$ Ex: There's no point in waiting for Ann.

10. $\text{Shall we} + \text{V?}$
$\hookrightarrow$ Ex: Shall we meet at 7 p.m?

20. S + had been + V(PII) (+ by O)
